A SPARK OF SOMETHING DIFFERENT

Good plans. Great people. Your kind of wedding.

WHY WE ARE HERE

A wedding should bring people together.
Planning it should, too.

Too often, planning a wedding means juggling suppliers, scattered messages, spreadsheets and payment dates. Beautiful plans become a lot of manual work. And with every decision, the costs add up.

We are building WedSparks to change that: one place to discover your suppliers, connect with them and organise the details of your day. Less admin between you and the wedding you actually want.

MAKE ROOM FOR A LITTLE MORE

Your wedding spending should help your wedding.

Earn $1,000 in free wedding credits for every $10,000 paid through WedSparks. Put them towards your next supplier payment—perhaps the flowers you loved, another hour of music, or simply less pressure on your budget.

These are credits for payments through WedSparks, rather than cash to withdraw. Amounts covered by credits do not earn more credits.

See how wedding credits work ↗

SUPPORTING THE PEOPLE BEHIND YOUR DAY

Good suppliers deserve more than a listing bill.

We know how frustrating it is to pay to be listed without knowing whether an enquiry will ever arrive. Your storefront and core tools on WedSparks are free. Suppliers pay an 18% commission on invoices couples pay through the platform.

Optional Couple Leads is $50 a month for suppliers who want to discover couples in their area who have chosen to hear from businesses. A subscription is optional; a great storefront and ordinary enquiries do not depend on it.
